subject: Novaro pilot sizing & pricing — next steps
messages:
From: Samir Khan <samir.k@novaro.com>
To: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Novaro pilot sizing - pricing questions

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo this morning — team found the streaming latency and the embedding rerank examples especially helpful. A few follow-ups from our side as we build the internal ask for procurement:

- Estimated monthly activity: 200M tokens (generation/chat), 15M embedding vectors (batch embedding requests), and ~5M tokens worth of rerank traffic (short candidate scoring).
- Target pilot duration: 90 days to validate throughput and quality.
- Procurement is looking for a ballpark target $/1M tokens to model the SOW. Our initial internal suggestion is $300–$450 per 1M tokens for the pilot (we expect to optimize later).

We also want to understand a recommended model composition for this workload (chat vs embeddings vs rerank) and any per-model unit adjustments you suggest for cost planning. Can you send a short breakdown (model split + expected unit econ) we can attach to the SOW?

Attaching the initial volume spreadsheet the procurement team shared (see separate attachment).

Appreciate it — Samir
Principal Product Manager
Novaro Inc.
From: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Khan <samir.k@novaro.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 13:05:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Novaro pilot sizing - pricing questions

Samir — thanks for the clear numbers and the spreadsheet. Summary below and a concrete ask so procurement has something to work with. I attached a quick econ sheet (redwood-quick-econ.xlsx) and a one-page mutual action plan (novaro-pilot-map.docx).

High-level read:
- Monthly tokens: 200M generation / chat, 5M rerank tokens, embeddings: 15M vector requests (~1 token-equivalent per vector request for cost modeling).
- Suggested pilot unit target: $350 per 1M tokens as a conservative starting point for the 90-day pilot (this sits in your $300–$450 band but gives room for initial overage).

Recommended model composition (traffic splits and rough unit adjustments):
- Chat generation (open-chat model family): 60% of token volume. Use a mid-tier chat model (quantized variant) for pilot — baseline unit: $350/1M tokens.
- Embeddings (embed-small + embed-large mix): 30% of calls by request count; embed compute billed primarily by vector unit. We model embeddings as equivalent to $120/1M tokens for planning (embeddings are cheaper per effective unit).
- Rerank/scoring (specialized short-context models): 10% of token volume but higher per-token compute — model as $900/1M tokens for the rerank slice during pilot (short sequences but heavier compute).

Concrete numbers for budgeting (monthly pilot):
- Chat: 200M * 60% = 120M chat tokens -> $350 * 120 = $42,000 (per 1M multiplier applied: 120 units of 1M)
- Embeddings: 15M vectors modeled as 15 token-units -> $120 * 15 = $1,800
- Rerank: 5M tokens * 10% allocation (we treat the 5M as the entire rerank pool) -> effectively 5 units of 1M -> $900 * 5 = $4,500
- Total monthly pilot run-rate: ~ $48,300 (ballpark).

Notes & assumptions:
- We assume continuous throughput with caching on repeat prefixes. If your usage is highly repetitive we can reduce chat costs via prefix caching and KV reuse.
- Embedding pricing can be structured by vector size and retrieval frequency; the number above is conservative.
- These are pilot estimates — final pricing for a committed Dedicated plan would be materially lower.

Next steps I propose:
1) Vanessa can provide an official pilot quote and confirm whether we can offer a one-time pilot credit to offset initial spikes.
2) Karthik can scope an SLO for latency for the rerank path (we should pin 95th percentile targets).
3) Samir / procurement to confirm acceptance of the $350/1M pilot target or provide a revised target.

If that looks reasonable I'll loop Monica (CS) for onboarding checklist and schedule the deployment window.

Best,
Priyom Das
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Khan <samir.k@novaro.com>, priyom_das <priyom@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Novaro pilot sizing - pricing questions

Samir / team — thanks Priyom for the breakdown. Quick commercial posture from our side:

- We can produce a formal pilot quote at $350/1M tokens with a placeholder monthly cap (to be finalized after procurement returns the signed MAP).
- Pilot credit — we can offer a one-time $10k onboarding credit (applies to the first 60 days) to reduce early runway risk.
- For embeddings we usually switch to per-vector pricing on the second month if volumes are stable; we'll show both options in the quote.

Action items:
- Samir: confirm whether Novaro can accept $350/1M as the modeled pilot rate OR provide a target within your $300–$450 band.
- Karthik: can you confirm 95p latency target for rerank (suggested <= 120ms) and whether that is achievable in the pilot infra?
- Monica: please prepare onboarding checklist & estimate time to seat (target < 2 weeks from MAP signature).

I'll assemble the pilot quote and send the DocuSign link once Samir confirms the target rate.

—Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Growth | Redwood Inference
